### Prepare data for VAE

```{python}
county_ids = df["county_id"].values
years = df["year"].values

unique_years = sorted(df["year"].unique())
year_to_idx = {yr: i for i, yr in enumerate(unique_years)}
year_indices = np.array([year_to_idx[yr] for yr in years])

# Drop identifiers from feature matrix
features_df = df.drop(columns=["county_id", "year"]).copy()

features_df["has_datacenter"] = features_df["has_datacenter"].astype(float)

# Year-Grouped Feature Scaling (Standardize features relative to each year's baseline)
scaled_chunks = []
for yr, group in features_df.groupby(df["year"]):
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaled_chunks.append(pd.DataFrame(scaler.fit_transform(group), index=group.index, columns=features_df.columns))

features_scaled = pd.concat(scaled_chunks).sort_index().values

X_tensor = torch.tensor(features_scaled, dtype=torch.float32)
year_tensor = torch.tensor(year_indices, dtype=torch.long)

dataset = TensorDataset(X_tensor, year_tensor)
train_loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=128, shuffle=True)

input_dim = X_tensor.shape[1]
num_years = len(unique_years)
```


```{python}
class TimeEmbeddedTabularVAE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_years, time_embed_dim=8, hidden_dim=128, latent_dim=16):
        super(TimeEmbeddedTabularVAE, self).__init__()
        
        # Trainable Year Embedding
        self.year_embedding = nn.Embedding(num_embeddings=num_years, embedding_dim=time_embed_dim)
        
        # Combined Input Dimension: Continuous Features + Year Embedding
        encoder_input_dim = input_dim + time_embed_dim
        
        # Encoder
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(encoder_input_dim, hidden_dim * 2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim * 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU()
        )
        
        # Latent Space (Mean & Log-Var)
        self.fc_mu = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, latent_dim)
        self.fc_logvar = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, latent_dim)
        
        # Decoder Input: Latent vector (z) + Year Embedding
        decoder_input_dim = latent_dim + time_embed_dim
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(decoder_input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim * 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, input_dim) # Reconstructs continuous features
        )

    def reparameterize(self, mu, logvar):
        std = torch.exp(0.5 * logvar)
        eps = torch.randn_like(std)
        return mu + eps * std

    def forward(self, x, year_idx):
        t_embed = self.year_embedding(year_idx) # Shape: (batch_size, time_embed_dim)
        
        # Concatenate features + year embedding for Encoder
        x_enc_input = torch.cat([x, t_embed], dim=1)
        h = self.encoder(x_enc_input)
        
        mu = self.fc_mu(h)
        logvar = self.fc_logvar(h)
        z = self.reparameterize(mu, logvar)
        
        # Concatenate latent vector + year embedding for Decoder
        z_dec_input = torch.cat([z, t_embed], dim=1)
        x_recon = self.decoder(z_dec_input)
        
        return x_recon, mu, logvar
```


```{python}
def vae_loss_function(recon_x, x, mu, logvar, beta=0.01):
    recon_loss = nn.functional.mse_loss(recon_x, x, reduction='sum')
    kl_loss = -0.5 * torch.sum(1 + logvar - mu.pow(2) - logvar.exp())
    return recon_loss + beta * kl_loss

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = TimeEmbeddedTabularVAE(
    input_dim=input_dim, 
    num_years=num_years, 
    time_embed_dim=8, 
    hidden_dim=128, 
    latent_dim=16
).to(device)

optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)

# Initialize list to store loss per epoch
loss_history = []

# Training Loop
epochs = 50
model.train()
for epoch in range(epochs):
    total_loss = 0.0
    for x_batch, year_batch in train_loader:
        x_batch = x_batch.to(device)
        year_batch = year_batch.to(device)
        
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        recon_batch, mu, logvar = model(x_batch, year_batch)
        loss = vae_loss_function(recon_batch, x_batch, mu, logvar, beta=0.01)
        
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        
    # Calculate average loss per sample for the epoch
    avg_epoch_loss = total_loss / len(train_loader.dataset)
    loss_history.append(avg_epoch_loss)
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch [{epoch+1}/{epochs}] - Loss per sample: {avg_epoch_loss:.4f}")
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(range(1, epochs + 1), loss_history, label="Training Loss")
plt.xlabel("Epoch")
plt.ylabel("Loss per Sample")
plt.title("VAE Training Loss Over Time")
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
